purpose: Auditable source-of-truth candidate for no-compromise custom faction law unit-family classification.
validationState: Conservative ontology facts are authored for exact custom unit SIDs. Shooter/melee facts are populated only when backed by custom_factions/unit_role_contracts.json joined through exact ability_overrides sourceMechanicId and branchRole metadata. These facts are not runtime-proven.
rules: Every unit entry must be keyed by exact custom unit SID.
Unknown must be used when evidence is incomplete.
No entry may be derived from donor unit identity, SID substring, display name, icon, visual prefab, animation folder, or broad faction assumption.

Conservative ontology facts may be authored only when the custom manifest explicitly owns the family concept for the exact line, such as Necropolis undead, Conflux elemental lines, Tower constructs, or manifest-authored living custom unit lines.

Shooter and melee facts may be authored only when backed by custom_factions/unit_role_contracts.json and joined through exact custom ability override sourceMechanicId and branchRole metadata. Uncontracted lines must remain unknown.
No entry may feed promoted gameplay until generated Core rows and in-context runtime diagnostics prove the same custom unit identity reaches the consuming hook.
GatedOrSummoned and corpseProducing facts must remain unknown until exact summon/lifetime or corpse-state surfaces are proven.
